questions.q: What toxic metal contaminated Flint's drinking water after the 2014 source switch?
questions.why: The overview states lead was present in the water.

questions.q: Which official role loses power when an emergency manager is installed in a city?
questions.why: The mayor basically loses power when an EM is installed.

questions.q: Who first alerted Dr. Mona Hanna‑Attisha to the hidden lead problem in Flint?
questions.why: A friend in D.C. tipped Mona off about the leaked memo.

questions.q: How long after the water source change did Michigan officials finally acknowledge the problem?
questions.why: The text notes it was almost 18 months before admission.

questions.q: What did Dan Wyant claim the state was using to protect Flint's water, despite evidence to the contrary?
questions.why: Wyant said officials were using corrosion control methods when they weren't.
